summary: BMO 2024-5C3 Mortgage Trust filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) to note that the mortgage loan secured by the Piazza Alta property is being serviced under a separate pooling and servicing agreement (BMO 2023-5C2 PSA). The filing is a routine operational disclosure about the servicing of an asset within a securitization trust. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or similar corporate action is described. The filing merely references existing servicing arrangements and includes no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisory roles.
